text:
Sam: Heads-up — ap-southeast1 spike: ~140 GPU pods stuck Pending after the rollout. Lots of "prebind waiting for taint" logs.
Infra-bot: alert: gpu-prod/ap-southeast1 pending=142 dashboard=https://console/alerts/1778889990
Maya: I think the new aggressive prebind + anchor-affinity landed together. Prebind wait increased and is hitting region taint-prop p95.
Leo: Logs:
```
I0907 02:11:12 scheduler: prebind wait=7.8s pod=job-99 node=gpux-apse1b-05
W0907 02:11:15 attach: nvattach queue depth=100/100 backpressure=high
```
Sam: Ops — can we rollback prebind for ap-southeast1 only? Prefer targeted rollback vs full revert.
Ops-SRE: Starting canary rollback to ap-southeast1a now. Will report in 5m.
Maya: Also propose temporary kubelet attach-concurrency bump (4->12) in apac as a mitigation.
Ops-SRE: Canary rollback applied to a/b/c at 1778889955. Early signal: pending dropped 142 -> 60 in ~90s.
Leo: After rollback + small attach-concurrency canary, pending down to ~18, eviction churn stopped.
Sam: Filing INF ticket to add per-region prebind safety gate and to make prebind-window adaptive to taint/conntrack p95.
Infra-bot: incident status -> mitigated at 1778889997. Monitoring dashboard: https://console/infra/metrics/gpu-pending/ap-southeast1
Maya: Will draft follow-up RFC for latebind fallback and region rollout guard.
Sam: Closing thread for now. Reopen if pending >50 for 10m. :thumbsup:
